name: zoom-controls
title: Zoom controls
description: Zoom out, the current level, zoom in and fit: one compact control for images, maps, documents and canvases, with keyboard shortcuts and limits.
docs: value is a scale (1 is 100 percent); presets are in percent. The keys work while focus is inside the parent of the controls, or inside scope, so the browser's own zoom keeps working elsewhere. onFit adds Fit to screen: you know the content size, so you work out the scale.
